'''High Flight Twelve''' was the callsign of an unknown [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] flying an [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]] during the [[Battle of Adumar]]. Being the first squadron to lift off during the conflict, the pilot provided useful information regarding [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE Defenders]] protecting the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] capital ships.<ref name="soa">''[[X-Wing: Starfighters of Adumar]]''</ref>
